create table temp_camp_validate as 
with huokuan_shop as (
                                                      
                        
                                                                       
    select  distinct grass_region
    ,cast(shop_id as bigint) shop_id
    ,t.grass_date
    from (
         select grass_region
         ,shop_id	
         ,program	
         ,case when activation_date=date'2025-11-16' then date'2025-11-05' else activation_date end activation_date                            
         ,tr_tag
         from dev_mkplpaidads_analytics.escrow_program_shop_list
    )
    cross join unnest (sequence(date '2026-02-01', date '2026-02-08', interval '1' day)) t (grass_date)
    where program='Escrow+GMS'  and t.grass_date>=activation_date
)
,campaign_base as (
    select
            grass_date,grass_region,campaign_id,shop_id,roi_two,
            date(campaign_start_datetime) as campaign_start_date,
            date(campaign_end_datetime) campaign_end_date
              from mp_paidads.dim_campaign__reg_s0_live
        where
            grass_date between  date '2026-02-01' and date '2026-02-08'
)
select  t1.*,t2.campaign_id,t2.roi_two,t2.campaign_start_date,t2.campaign_end_date
from huokuan_shop t1
left join campaign_base t2 
on t1.shop_id=t2.shop_id and t1.grass_region=t2.grass_region and t1.grass_date = t2.grass_date

with escrow_shop_list as (
    select distinct
        grass_region
        ,shop_id
        ,program
        ,case
            when grass_region = 'MY' and activation_date = date('2025-11-16') then date('2025-11-01')
            else activation_date
        end activation_date
        ,tr_tag
    from dev_mkplpaidads_analytics.escrow_program_shop_list
    where grass_region in ('MY')
)
,plt_gmv_shop as (
    select
        grass_date
        ,month(grass_date) as month_rn
        ,grass_region
        ,shop_id
        ,sum(gmv_usd * atc_prorate * first_touchpoint_item) as plt_gmv_usd
        ,sum(order_fraction * atc_prorate * first_touchpoint_item) as plt_order_1d
    from traffic_omni_oa.dwd_order_item_atc_journey_di__reg_sensitive_live
    where
        grass_region in ('MY')
        and (grass_date between date('2025-12-01') and date('2025-12-31') or grass_date between date('2026-01-01') and date('2026-01-31'))                                          
        and tz_type = 'local'
        and first_touchpoint_item = 1
        and user_id > 0
        and user_id is not null
        and order_item_id is not null
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4
)
,plt_gmv_shop_bef as (
    select
        grass_region
        ,shop_id
        ,sum(plt_gmv_usd) plt_gmv_usd
        ,sum(plt_order_1d) as plt_order_cnt
    from plt_gmv_shop
    where
        grass_date between date('2025-12-01') and date('2025-12-31')                     
    group by 1, 2
)
,plt_gmv_shop_aft as (
    select
        grass_region
        ,shop_id
        ,sum(plt_gmv_usd) plt_gmv_usd
        ,sum(plt_order_1d) as plt_order_cnt
    from plt_gmv_shop
    where
        grass_date between date('2026-01-01') and date('2026-01-31')                    
    group by 1, 2
)
,balance_base_bef as (
    select grass_date
    ,grass_region
    ,shop_id
    ,coalesce(total_eod_balance_usd_td,0) total_eod_balance_usd_td
    from mp_paidads.dws_advertiser_balance_td__reg_s0_live
    where grass_date = date('2025-11-30')
    and grass_region in ('MY')
    and tz_type = 'local'
)
,balance_base_aft as (
    select grass_date
    ,grass_region
    ,shop_id
    ,coalesce(total_eod_balance_usd_td,0) total_eod_balance_usd_td
    from mp_paidads.dws_advertiser_balance_td__reg_s0_live
    where grass_date = date('2025-12-31')
    and grass_region in ('MY')
    and tz_type = 'local'
)
,topup_bef as (
    select grass_region
    ,shop_id
    ,ads_program_topup_amt_usd
    ,topup_amt_usd - ads_program_topup_amt_usd as manual_topup_amt_usd
    from 
    (select
        grass_region
        ,t1.shop_id
        ,coalesce(sum(case when grass_region = 'MY' and order_type_name = 'Topup Manual' and credit_topup_sub_type_name in ('local top up - non gss', 'ads spending growth') and credit_program_name = '2025_0085_MY_AD_Ads Growth Plan' then topup_amt_usd
                when grass_region = 'SG' and credit_topup_sub_type_name = 'local top up - gss' and credit_program_name = 'Paid growth service subscription' then topup_amt_usd end),0) ads_program_topup_amt_usd
        ,coalesce(sum(topup_amt_usd),0) topup_amt_usd
    from
        mp_paidads.dwd_advertiser_credit_topup_df__reg_s0_live t1
    where
        t1.grass_date between date('2025-12-01') and date('2025-12-31')
        and date(topup_create_datetime)= grass_date
        and t1.grass_region in ('MY')
        and t1.tz_type = 'local'
    group by 1, 2)
)
,topup_aft as (
    select grass_region
    ,shop_id
    ,ads_program_topup_amt_usd
    ,topup_amt_usd - ads_program_topup_amt_usd as manual_topup_amt_usd
    from 
    (select
        grass_region
        ,t1.shop_id
        ,coalesce(sum(case when grass_region = 'MY' and order_type_name = 'Topup Manual' and credit_topup_sub_type_name in ('local top up - non gss', 'ads spending growth') and credit_program_name = '2025_0085_MY_AD_Ads Growth Plan' then topup_amt_usd
                when grass_region = 'SG' and credit_topup_sub_type_name = 'local top up - gss' and credit_program_name = 'Paid growth service subscription' then topup_amt_usd end),0) ads_program_topup_amt_usd
        ,coalesce(sum(topup_amt_usd),0) topup_amt_usd
    from
        mp_paidads.dwd_advertiser_credit_topup_df__reg_s0_live t1
    where
        t1.grass_date between date('2026-01-01') and date('2026-01-31')
        and date(topup_create_datetime)= grass_date
        and t1.grass_region in ('MY')
        and t1.tz_type = 'local'
    group by 1, 2)
)
,ads_perf_bef as (
    select
        grass_region
        ,shop_id
        ,sum(ads_expenditure_amt_usd) ads_rev
    from mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
    where
        tz_type = 'local'
        and (
            is_ads_active = 1
            or has_performance = 1
        )
        and grass_region in ('MY')
        and (grass_date between date('2025-12-01') and date('2025-12-31'))
    group by 1, 2
)
,ads_perf_aft as (
    select
        grass_region
        ,shop_id
        ,sum(ads_expenditure_amt_usd) ads_rev
    from mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_

with total_campaign as (
    select distinct grass_region,grass_date,shop_id,campaign_id 
    ,sum(expenditure_amt_usd) as ads_revenue_usd
    from mp_paidads.dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live
    where (grass_date between date'2026-01-16' and date'2026-01-22' or grass_date=date'2026-01-25')  
    and grass_region in ('ID')
    and pricing_type in (11,15)                     
    and ads_id > 0 
    group by 1,2,3,4
)
,problem_1 as (
    select t1.grass_region,t1.grass_date,t1.L1,t1.item_price_tag,shop_id,campaign_id
    from 
        (select grass_region,grass_date,date_period,L1,item_price_tag 
        ,approx_percentile(ads_imp_cnt,0.05) as ads_imp_cnt_p05 
        from dev_mkplpaidads_analytics.problem_1_low_ads_impression
        group by 1,2,3,4,5 
        order by 1,3,4,5 
        ) t1 
    left join dev_mkplpaidads_analytics.problem_1_low_ads_impression  t2
    on t1.grass_date=t2.grass_date
    and t1.L1=t2.L1
    and t1.item_price_tag=t2.item_price_tag
    where t2.ads_imp_cnt < ads_imp_cnt_p05          
)

select t1.grass_region,t1.grass_date
,case 
        when t1.grass_date between date'2026-01-16' and date'2026-01-22' then 'BAU' 
        when t1.grass_date=date'2026-01-25' then 'Campaign day'
        else 'others' end as date_period
,question_tag,problem_level
,count(distinct t1.shop_id) as seller_cnt 
,count(distinct t1.campaign_id) as campaign_cnt 
,sum(ads_revenue_usd) as ads_revenue_usd
from total_campaign t1 
left join 
    (select grass_region,grass_date,'问题1:流量获取-无曝光或曝光极低' as question_tag,null as problem_level,shop_id,campaign_id from problem_1 
    union all select grass_region,grass_date,question_tag,problem_level,shop_id,campaign_id from dev_mkplpaidads_analytics.problem_2_no_conversion_v2
    union all select grass_region,grass_date,question_tag,problem_level,shop_id,campaign_id from dev_mkplpaidads_analytics.problem_3_high_cpa
    union all select grass_region,grass_date,question_tag,problem_level,shop_id,campaign_id from dev_mkplpaidads_analytics.problem_4_conversion_drop_v2
    ) t2 
on t1.grass_region=t2.grass_region and t1.grass_date=t2.grass_date and t1.shop_id=t2.shop_id and t1.campaign_id=t2.campaign_id 
group by 1,2,3,4,5

select * from (with raw_date as
    (
    select cspu_id
                                  
        ,winner_cnt
        ,least(coalesce(winner_weighted_avg_price_by_order,99999999),coalesce(second_cheapest_incl_2nd_promo_weighted_avg_price_by_order,99999999))winner_weighted_avg_price_by_order
        ,least(coalesce(winner_avg_price_incl_no_order_part,99999999),coalesce(second_cheapest_incl_2nd_promo_incl_no_order_part,99999999))winner_avg_price_incl_no_order_part

with ads_shop_base as (

            when mkt.pricing_type in (24, 27) then 'GMS'  
            when mkt.pricing_type in (11, 15) then 'Target+Simple'   
        end as ads_types

        mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live mkt

        on mkt.grass_region = dim.grass_region  
        and mkt.campaign_id = dim.campaign_id  
        and mkt.grass_date = dim.grass_date                  
        and dim.tz_type = 'local'

        mkt.tz_type = 'local'  
        and (mkt.is_ads_active = 1 or mkt.has_performance = 1)

        and mkt.grass_date = date('2026-01-25')

        and mkt.ads_expenditure_amt_usd > 0

        on mkt.grass_region = dim.grass_region  
        and mkt.campaign_id = dim.campaign_id

        and dim.tz_type = 'local'  
    where   
        mkt.tz_type = 'local'  
        and (mkt.is_ads_active = 1 or mkt.has_performance = 1)  
        and mkt.main_product_type = 'Product Ads'  
        and mkt.pricing_type in (11, 15, 24, 27)

    select

        ,case

, continous_retention as (
    with retention_3d as (
        select
            a.grass_region
            ,a.grass_date
            ,d1_shop_id
            ,d1_item_id
            ,d3_grass_date
            ,d3_shop_id
            ,d3_item_id

        where

            and a.grass_date =  date_parse('20260210', '%Y%m%d')
            and a.pricing_type in (11, 15)
            and (d3_grass_date is not null)
    )
    ,retention_7d as (
        select
            a.grass_region
            ,grass_date
            ,d1_shop_id
            ,d1_item_id
            ,d7_grass_date
            ,d7_shop_id
            ,d7_item__id as d7_item_id
        from mkplpaidads_analytics.retention_xd_shopid_itemid a
        where
            a.grass_region in ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'BR')
            and grass_date =  date_parse('20260210', '%Y%m%d')
            and pricing_type in (11, 15)
            and (d7_grass_date is not null)
    )
    ,retention_14d as (
        select
            a.grass_region
            ,grass_date
            ,d1_shop_id
            ,d1_item_id
            ,d14_grass_date
            ,d14_shop_id
            ,d14_item_id
        from mkplpaidads_analytics.retention_xd_shopid_itemid a
        where
            a.grass_region in ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'BR')
            and grass_date =  date_parse('20260210', '%Y%m%d')
            and pricing_type in (11, 15)
            and (d14_grass_date is not null)
    )
    select
        r3.grass_region
        ,r3.item_cnt
        ,d3_item_cnt
        ,r7.item_cnt
        ,d7_item_cnt
        ,r14.item_cnt
        ,d14_item_cnt
    from
        (
            select
                a.grass_region
                ,count(distinct d1_item_id) as item_cnt
                ,count(distinct d3_item_id) as d3_item_cnt
            from
                retention_3d a
                join (
                    select a.grass_region, a.grass_date, a.item_id, a.shop_id, coalesce(b.direct_order_cnt_7d, 0) as direct_order_cnt_7d from dim_ads_item a 
                    left join ads_order b on a.grass_region = b.grass_region and a.item_id = b.item_id

                ) b on a.grass_region = b.grass_region

            select

                ,count(distinct d7_item_id) as d7_item_cnt
            from
                retention_7d a
                join (
                    select a.grass_region, a.grass_date, a.item_id, a.shop_id, coalesce(b.direct_order_cnt_7d, 0) as direct_order_cnt_7d from dim_ads_item a 
                    left join ads_order b on a.grass_region = b.grass_region and a.item_id = b.item_id
                    where  coalesce(b.direct_order_cnt_7d, 0) <3
                ) b on a.grass_region = b.grass_region
                and a.d1_shop_id = b.shop_id
                and a.d1_item_id = b.item_id
            group by 1
        ) r7 on r3.grass_region = r7.grass_region
        join (
            select
                a.grass_region
                ,count(distinct d1_item_id) as item_cnt
                ,count(distinct d14_item_id) as d14_item_cnt
            fro

WITH non_zero_deduction AS (

    FROM mp_paidads.dwd_advertiser_deduction_di__reg_s0_live

)

SELECT
    grass_region,
    placement,
    CASE WHEN budget_or_balance_exhausted = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS budget_or_balance_exhausted,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ads_id) AS ads_count,
    AVG(last_deduction_time - first_deduction_time)/3600.00 AS lasting_hour,
    grass_date
FROM non_zero_deduction
GROUP BY grass_region, placement, budget_or_balance_exhausted, grass_date

with budget_data_tb as (
                          
    select
        grass_date
        ,grass_region
        ,campaign_id
        ,max(campaign_valid_budget_usd) as valid_budget
    from mp_paidads.ads_campaign_valid_budget_1d__reg_s0_live
    where
        grass_region in ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'BR')
        and grass_date = date_parse('20260210', '%Y%m%d')
        and tz_type = 'local'
        and pricing_type in (11,15)
    group by 1, 2, 3
)
,hit_hour_tb as (
                          
    select
        grass_date
        ,grass_region
        ,placement
                  
        , campaign_id
        ,min(if(accu_revs >= 0.9 * valid_budget_bucket, hh, 24)) as hit_hour          
    from
        (
                             
            select
                a.grass_date
                ,a.grass_region
                ,a.placement
                ,a.campaign_id
                ,a.ads_id
                                  
                ,a.hh
                ,a.cost_usd
                ,sum(a.cost_usd) over (
                    partition by a.grass_date, a.grass_region, a.placement, a.ads_id
                    order by a.hh
                ) as accu_revs
                ,b.valid_budget as valid_budget_bucket
            from
                (
                    select
                        grass_date
                        ,grass_region
                        ,placement
                        ,campaign_id
                        ,ads_id
                                
                                                                     
                                                                                           
                                          
                                                
                        ,case
                            when grass_region = 'SG' then hour(
                                from_unixtime(event_timestamp) at time zone 'Asia/Singapore'
                            )
                            when grass_region = 'TW' then hour(from_unixtime(event_timestamp) at time zone 'Asia/Taipei')
                            when grass_region = 'PH' then hour(from_unixtime(event_timestamp) at time zone 'Asia/Manila')
                            when grass_region = 'MY' then hour(
                                from_unixtime(event_timestamp) at time zone 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'
                            )
                            when grass_region = 'TH' then hour(from_unixtime(event_timestamp) at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')
                            when grass_region = 'VN' then hour(
                                from_unixtime(event_timestamp) at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'
                            )
                            when grass_region = 'ID' then hour(from_unixtime(event_timestamp) at time zone 'Asia/Jakarta')
                            when grass_region = 'BR' then hour(from_unixtime(event_timestamp) at time zone 'Brazil/East')
                            when grass_region = 'MX' then hour(
                                from_unixtime(event_timestamp) at time zone 'America/Mexico_City'
                            )
                        end as hh
                        ,sum(deduction_amt_usd) as cost_usd
                                                               
                    from
                                                                              
                        mp_paidads.dwd_advertiser_deduction_di__reg_s0_live
                    where
                        1 = 1
                        and grass_region in ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'BR')
                        and grass_date = date_parse('20260210', '%Y%m%d')
                        and placement in (40, 50) 
                        and pricing_type in (11, 15)
                        and tz_type = 'local'
                    group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
                ) as a
                join budget_data_tb as b on a.grass_date = b.grass_date
                and a.grass_region = b.grass_region
                and a.campaign_id = b.campaign_id
        )
                
                                                                   
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4
)
, ads_order as (select
                campaign_id
                ,grass_region
                ,sum(order_cnt) as direct_order_cnt_7d
            from mp_paidads.dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live
            where
                pricing_type in (11,15)

                and grass_date between date_parse('20260210', '%Y%m%d') - interval '6' day and date_parse('20260210', '%Y%m%d')
                and tz_type = 'local'
                and campaign_id is not null
            group by 1, 2
            )
select a.grass_region

create table dev_video_bi.tmp_roi3_user_test_th_1231 as
with user_metrics as (
select   t.grass_region
, t.grass_date
, t.group_tag
, t.user_id
, sum(t1.platform_gmv) as platform_gmv
, sum(t2.gross_rev_all) as gross_rev_all
from
(
	select   grass_region
	, date(date_parse('20251231', '%Y%m%d')) as grass_date
	, user_id
	, group_name as group_tag
	from     mpi_prom.mpi_pi_ads_voucher_blacklist_user_monthly
	where    start_date = date '2026-01-01'
	and      group_name in ('mp_plus_ads', 'control', 'mp_only')
	and      grass_region in ('TH')
	group by 1, 2, 3, 4
) t

              
left outer join 
(
    select   grass_region
    , grass_date
    , user_id
    , sum(gmv_usd * atc_prorate * first_touchpoint_item) as platform_gmv
    from     traffic_omni_oa.dwd_order_item_atc_journey_di__reg_sensitive_live
    where    grass_date = date(date_parse('20251231', '%Y%m%d'))
    and      grass_region in ('TH')
    and      tz_type = 'local'
    group by 1, 2, 3
) t1
	on  t.user_id = t1.user_id
	and t.grass_date = t1.grass_date
	and t.grass_region = t1.grass_region

left outer join
(
    select   grass_region
    , grass_date
    , user_id
    , sum(expenditure_amt_usd) as gross_rev_all
    from     mp_paidads.dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live
    where    grass_date = date(date_parse('20251231', '%Y%m%d'))
    and      grass_region in ('TH')
    and      ads_id > 0
    and      tz_type = 'local'
    group by 1, 2, 3
) t2
    on  t.user_id = t2.user_id
	and t.grass_date = t2.grass_date
	and t.grass_region = t2.grass_region
group by 1, 2, 3, 4
)




select   t.grass_region
, t.grass_date
, cast(t.group_tag as varchar) as group_name
, count(distinct t.user_id) as user_cnt
, sum(t.platform_gmv) as platform_gmv
, sum(cast(t3.pc2 as double)) as pc2
, sum(coalesce(cast(t3.prm as double), 0)) as prm
, sum(t.gross_rev_all) as gross_rev_all
, sum(t3.paid_ads_revenue_usd) as paid_ads_revenue_usd
, (sum(t3.pc2) - sum(t3.paid_ads_revenue_usd) + sum(t.gross_rev_all)/1.04) as pc2_new
from
(
	select   t.grass_region
	, t.grass_date
	, t.group_tag
	, t.user_id
	, sum(t.platform_gmv) as platform_gmv
	, sum(t.gross_rev_all) as gross_rev_all
	from
	(
		select   t.grass_region
		, t.grass_date
		, t.group_tag
		, t.user_id
        , t.platform_gmv
        , t.gross_rev_all
		, row_number() over(partition by t.grass_region, t.grass_date, t.group_tag order by t.platform_gmv desc nulls last) as rank
		, sum(if(t.platform_gmv is not null, 1, 0)) over(partition by t.grass_region, t.grass_date, t.group_tag) as cnt
		from
		(
			select   grass_region
			, grass_date
			, group_tag
			, user_id
			, sum(platform_gmv) as platform_gmv
			, sum(gross_rev_all) as gross_rev_all
			from     user_metrics
			group by 1, 2, 3, 4
		) t	
		group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
	) t
	where t.rank > ceil(t.cnt * 0.0005) 
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4
) t

     
left outer join
(
	select   'TH' as grass_region
	, grass_date
	, user_id
	, sum(buyer_shp_pc2_usd) as pc2
	, sum(net_total_cost_usd) as prm
	, sum(bv_paid_ads_revenue_usd) as paid_ads_revenue_usd
	from     thbi_de.dwd_shp_pnl_analytics_di_s1
	where    grass_date = date(date_parse('20251231', '%Y%m%d'))
	and      month(grass_month) = month(date(date_parse('20251231', '%Y%m%d')))
	group by 1, 2, 3
) t3
	on  t.user_id = t3.user_id
	and t.grass_date = t3.grass_date
	and t.grass_region = t3.grass_region
group by 1, 2, 3

query_sql:
with rcmd as
(
select 
distinct shop_id
    from traffic.sellercenter_dwd_impression_di__reg_live
    where grass_date between date_parse('20260211','%Y%m%d')- interval '14' day and date_parse('20260211','%Y%m%d')
    and grass_region='ID'
    and (
        (page_type='seller_center_ads_homepage' and element_at(page_section,1)='to_do_list' and target_type='to_do_list' and json_extract_scalar(data,'$.card_info.card_type') in ('potential_item_v2','potential_item')
        )
        or
        (page_type='seller_center_new_homepage' and element_at(page_section,1)='ads_panel' and target_type='recommendation_card_imp' and json_extract_scalar(data,'$.card_type') in ('potential_item_v2','potential_item'))
    )

),
                       
ads as 
(select distinct shop_id from mp_paidads.dim_advertise__reg_s0_live where grass_date=date_parse('20260211','%Y%m%d') and grass_region in ('ID')
and date(ads_create_datetime)>=date('2025-01-01'))
,tier as 
(
    select distinct a.grass_region
    ,a.shop_id
    ,case when seller_tier = 'large_seller' then 'a.large_seller'
        when seller_tier = 'medium_seller' then 'b.medium_seller'
        when seller_tier = 'small_seller' then 'c.small_seller'
        when seller_tier = 'micro_seller' then 'd.micro_seller'
    end as seller_tier
    ,case when advertiser_tier = 'large_advertiser' then 'a.large_advertiser'
        when advertiser_tier = 'medium_advertiser' then 'b.medium_advertiser'
        when advertiser_tier = 'small_advertiser' then 'c.small_advertiser'
        when advertiser_tier = 'micro_advertiser' then 'd.micro_advertiser'
    end as advertiser_tier
    ,a.grass_date
    from mp_paidads.ads_advertiser_seller_all_metrics_1d__reg_s0_live a
    where tz_type = 'local'
    and a.grass_date=date_parse('20260211','%Y%m%d')
    and a.grass_region in ('ID')
    and seller_status in ('reactivated','existing')
)

select 
distinct a.shop_id
from rcmd a
join tier c on a.shop_id=c.shop_id
left join ads d on a.shop_id=d.shop_id
where seller_tier in ('b.medium_seller','c.small_seller')
and d.shop_id is null
limit 3

shop_id,
t_if_reduce_roi_displayed,
t_campaign_id,
t_item_id
from traffic.sellercenter_dwd_impression_di__reg_live
cross join unnest(
        cast(json_extract(data,'$.campaign_list') as array(row(campaign_id bigint,if_reduce_roi_displayed_v2 varchar,item_id bigint))
    )) as t(t_campaign_id,t_if_reduce_roi_displayed,t_item_id)
where grass_date between date('2026-01-21') and date('2026-02-02')
and tz_type = 'local'
and grass_region in ('TH','PH','VN','BR','MY','TW','SG','ID')
and (                                                                                 
(page_type='seller_center_shopee_ads' and element_at(page_section,1)='all_cpc_ads_list' and target_type='all_cpc_ads_list')                                                                                                                  
)
)
,target_roas as 
(
select 
distinct
a.ads_id
,a.item_id
,a.shop_id
,a.campaign_id
,a.grass_region
,a.grass_date
,1.0/cir target_roi
from mp_paidads.dwd_seller_cir__reg_s0_live a
join (select distinct campaign_id,shop_id,grass_region from mp_paidads.dim_campaign__reg_s0_live where grass_date=date('2026-02-02')
and grass_region in ('TH','PH','VN','B

select   t.grass_region
, t.seller_tier
, sum(t.seller_cnt) as seller_cnt
, sum(t.prm) as prm
, sum(t.seller_voucher_amt) as seller_voucher_amt
, sum(t.platform_voucher_amt) as platform_voucher_amt
, sum(t.platform_gmv) as platform_gmv
from
(
	select   t.grass_region
	, t.grass_date
	, t1.seller_tier
	, count(distinct t.shop_id) as seller_cnt
	, sum(t.prm) as prm
	, sum(t2.seller_voucher_amt) as seller_voucher_amt
	, sum(t2.platform_voucher_amt) as platform_voucher_amt
	, sum(t3.platform_gmv) as platform_gmv
	from
	(
		select   'MY' as grass_region
		, grass_date
		, shop_id
		, sum(prm_before_margin_usd) as prm
		from     mybi_general.dr_order_item_level_mp_pc2_final
		where    grass_date >= date '2026-02-04'
		and      grass_date <= date '2026-02-10'
		group by 1, 2, 3
	) t	

	join
	(
	    select   grass_region
	    , grass_date
	    , shop_id
        , seller_tier
        from     mp_paidads.ads_advertiser_seller_all_metrics_1d__reg_s0_live
		where    grass_date >= date '2026-02-04'
		and      grass_date <= date '2026-02-10'
        and      grass_region in ('MY')
        group by 1, 2, 3, 4
	) t1
		on  t.shop_id = t1.shop_id
		and t.grass_date = t1.grass_date
		and t.grass_region = t1.grass_region	

	left outer join
	(
		select   'MY' as grass_region
		, grass_date
		, shop_id
		, sum(if(type like '%sv%', voucher_rebate_usd, 0)) as seller_voucher_amt
		, sum(if(type like '%pv%', voucher_rebate_usd, 0)) as platform_voucher_amt
		from     mybi_general.cc_voucher_rebate_prm_v2
		where    grass_date >= date '2026-02-04'
		and      grass_date <= date '2026-02-10'
		group by 1, 2, 3
	) t2
		on  t.shop_id = t2.shop_id
		and t.grass_date = t2.grass_date
		and t.grass_region = t2.grass_region	

	left outer join
	(
	    select   grass_region
	    , grass_date
	    , shop_id
	    , sum(gmv_usd * atc_prorate * first_touchpoint_item) as platform_gmv
	    from     traffic_omni_oa.dwd_order_item_atc_journey_di__reg_sensitive_live
		where    grass_date >= date '2026-02-04'
		and      grass_date <= date '2026-02-10'
	    and      grass_region in ('MY')
	    and      tz_type = 'local'
	    group by 1, 2, 3
	) t3
		on  t.shop_id = t3.shop_id
		and t.grass_date = t3.grass_date
		and t.grass_region = t3.grass_region
	group by 1, 2, 3
) t
group by 1, 2
